name: stocks-rag eval set - Oracle Financial Services Software Ltd (OFSS), Annual Report 2025-26
description: Hand-made from the original PDF text (not from the app's output). Requests filter on company OFSS (and period FY26 where the answer is in this report).

how_to_grade.must_contain: Every inner list is one required fact; the answer passes it if it contains ANY of the strings in that list (case-insensitive). All inner lists must pass.
how_to_grade.must_not_contain: None of these strings may appear (catches wrong columns / wrong numbers).
how_to_grade.expected_pages: At least one returned source must have one of these page values (sources[].pages can be a range like '1-2'; count it if the range covers the page).
how_to_grade.expect_not_found: true = the answer must be the not-found reply ('I could not find this in the ingested filings.') and must not invent a figure.
how_to_grade.calculated: true = the figure is NOT printed in the filing; the answer should derive it and say it is calculated.
how_to_grade.accept_any_of: For ambiguous questions: the answer passes if it matches any one listed interpretation AND states which period it used.
how_to_grade.needs_judge: true = deterministic checks are not enough on their own; an LLM judge should also review the answer (see judge_focus).

request.question: What was OFSS's consolidated revenue from operations for FY26?

expected_response.answer: Consolidated revenue from operations for the year ended 31 March 2026 was ₹ 76,721 million (about ₹ 76.7 billion), up 12% from ₹ 68,468 million [S1].

cases.source_note: Financial highlights (consolidated), p8; letter p3 says ₹76.7 billion

request.question: What was the consolidated net profit for FY26?

expected_response.answer: Consolidated profit for the year ended 31 March 2026 was ₹ 26,393 million, up 11% from ₹ 23,796 million [S1].

cases.source_note: p8 consolidated highlights; p3 says net income ₹26.4 billion, +11%

request.question: By what percentage did consolidated revenue grow in FY26?

expected_response.answer: Consolidated revenue grew 12% year-on-year, to ₹ 76,721 million from ₹ 68,468 million [S1].

cases.source_note: p3 and p8

request.question: What was OFSS's standalone revenue from operations for FY26?

expected_response.answer: Standalone revenue from operations for FY26 was ₹ 57,167 million, up 12% from ₹ 50,991 million [S1].

cases.source_note: p8 standalone highlights; p133 standalone P&L

request.question: What was the standalone net profit for FY26 and how did it change from the previous year?

expected_response.answer: Standalone profit for FY26 was ₹ 27,746 million, down 17% from ₹ 33,507 million in FY25 [S1].

cases.source_note: p8: 'down by 17%'; p133 standalone P&L

request.question: Why did standalone total income fall in FY26 even though revenue grew?

expected_response.answer: Other income dropped from ₹ 17,210 million to ₹ 6,800 million, so standalone total income fell from ₹ 68,201 million to ₹ 63,967 million despite revenue rising to ₹ 57,167 million [S1]. (The cash flow shows dividend from subsidiaries fell from ₹ 15,199 million to ₹ 4,334 million.)

cases.source_note: p8 standalone highlights

request.question: What was OFSS's standalone total assets as at 31 March 2026?

expected_response.answer: Standalone total assets were ₹ 78,633 million as at 31 March 2026 (₹ 83,280 million a year earlier) [S1].

cases.source_note: Standalone balance sheet p132 (typed table page)

request.question: What was the standalone basic earnings per share for FY26?

expected_response.answer: Standalone basic EPS for FY26 was ₹ 319.10 (diluted ₹ 317.60), face value ₹ 5 [S1].

cases.source_note: Standalone P&L p133 (typed table page)

request.question: What was the consolidated basic earnings per share for FY26?

expected_response.answer: Consolidated basic EPS for FY26 was ₹ 303.54 (diluted ₹ 302.11) [S1].

cases.source_note: Consolidated P&L p63; note 23 p91

request.question: What dividends did OFSS declare for FY26?

expected_response.answer: 1st interim dividend of ₹ 130 per share (17 Oct 2025) and 2nd interim dividend of ₹ 270 per share (22 Apr 2026), face value ₹ 5; no additional final dividend was recommended [S1].

cases.source_note: Directors' report p8

request.question: What was the total dividend per share declared for FY26?

expected_response.answer: Calculated: ₹ 400 per share = 1st interim ₹ 130 + 2nd interim ₹ 270 [S1]; no final dividend.
